epics.title: System Containerization and Deployment
epics.jtbd: When running the product locally, I want to start the full stack with a single command, so that I can verify its real-world behavior and observability.
requirements: R1: Add a docker-compose.yml at the repository root that starts the full stack and exposes a health-check endpoint.

slices.title: Add Docker Compose configuration
slices.jtbd: When implementing the containerization setup for this epic, I want to provide a docker-compose file, so that the full stack can be started with a single command.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a clean repository state, When a user runs docker-compose up, Then the full stack starts successfully and exposes a health-check endpoint.
Given the containers are running, When the tests are executed, Then they pass successfully.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce full stack local startup commands from 4 to 1

epics.title: Epidemiological Material Cataloging and Management
epics.jtbd: When I manage the epidemiology knowledge base, I want to catalog and update materials, so that the information is structured and up to date.
requirements: R1: Invoke corresponding PUT API endpoint from the frontend to update materials.
R2: Invoke corresponding DELETE API endpoint from the frontend to delete materials.

slices.title: Implement frontend UI for updating and deleting materials
slices.jtbd: When implementing the management UI for this epic, I want to add update and delete capabilities to the existing material views, so that users can maintain the catalog.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material in the catalog, When the user clicks delete, Then the frontend calls the DELETE endpoint and removes the item from the list.
Given an existing material, When the user edits it, Then the frontend calls the PUT endpoint and updates the displayed data.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: increase UI coverage of material CRUD operations from 50% to 100%

epics.title: System Authentication and Authorization
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce unauthorized API access incidents to 0
requirements: R1: Implement authentication and session mechanism to block unauthenticated access to the catalog and creation endpoints.

slices.title: Implement basic authentication and session mechanism
slices.jtbd: When implementing the security mechanism for this epic, I want to add authentication checks, so that unauthenticated users are blocked.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to access the catalog, Then they are blocked and prompted to log in.
Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to create a material, Then they receive an unauthorized error and are prompted to log in.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: increase authentication coverage of restricted endpoints from 0% to 100%
